title: Charlie's career turns to medical art and imaging after Allagash
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Charlie's career turns to medical art and imaging after Allagash, about after 1976 at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was training myself to be a school teacher

plain: Charlie Foltz is one of a group of men who say they were taken by alien beings during a 1976 camping trip on the Allagash Waterway, a river route in Maine. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that before that trip he was training to be a school teacher. He says afterwards his career turned toward medical art and imaging, a change he links to what he says happened to him.
